# What Is the Binance MCP Server?

Published on 2026-08-20 09:52

**General**

#### **What is the Binance MCP Server?**

The Binance MCP Server is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint that lets MCP-compatible AI agents connect to Binance using a single URL and an authorization flow. Depending on the permissions you grant and your account eligibility, your agent can access market data, view account information for an Agentic sub-account, place supported trades, and transfer funds between wallets within the same Agentic sub-account.

#### **What is MCP?**

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that allows AI agents to connect to external applications and services through a structured tool interface. With MCP access, an AI agent can request data and, where permitted, initiate actions through connected services.

#### **What is the MCP endpoint URL?**

Use this endpoint URL in supported AI agents:

https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic

#### **Do you need to install anything locally or manage API keys?**

To connect, add the endpoint URL in your AI agent and complete an authorization flow. If your setup does not require locally generated API keys, do not store API keys on your device for this connection. Availability and exact steps vary by agent.

**What can your AI agent do?**

#### **What can your agent do once connected?**

Based on the scopes you grant, your AI agent can typically:

- Read market data, such as tickers, order books, candlesticks, and funding rates.
- View balances and positions in your Agentic sub-account. Some setups may also provide a read-only view of certain main-account information, if enabled.
- Place trades for supported products, such as Spot, Margin, Convert, USDⓈ-M Futures, and COIN-M Futures, where available and authorized.
- Transfer funds between wallets within the same Agentic sub-account (for example, Spot Account to USDⓈ-M Account).

#### **What are example prompts to use?**

Examples (edit to match your risk preferences and enabled scopes):

- “What’s the current BTCUSDT price and 24h change?”
- “Show my Agentic sub-account balances across accounts.”
- “Place a market buy for $100 of BNB on Spot.”
- “Convert 500 USDT to BNB.”
- “Transfer 2,000 USDT from Spot Account to USDⓈ-M Account in my Agentic sub-account.”

#### **Do read actions run without confirmation?**

Read actions typically retrieve information only, such as market data or balances. They **do not** place orders or transfer funds.

#### **Do trades and transfers require confirmation?**

Many AI agents and tool flows are designed to request confirmation before executing actions that can place orders, cancel orders, or transfer funds. Always review the final details shown in your agent before confirming, because confirmations can execute real trades or transfers.

**Permissions and scopes**

#### **What scopes are available, and what does each allow?**

Scopes determine what the AI agent is allowed to do. Below list the permissions made available for users to configure their AI’s protocols:

- **Market data** (public): Access market data, such as tickers, order books, candlesticks, and funding rates.
- **Account**: View Agentic sub-account balances, positions, and account history. Some configurations may allow limited, read-only visibility into main-account information.
- **Trade**: Place and manage orders for products you enable and your account is eligible to use.
- **Transfer**: Move funds between accounts within the same Agentic sub-account.

#### **Can the AI agent withdraw funds to an external address?**

The Binance MCP Server does **not** provide a withdrawal scope for on-chain or external withdrawals. If you need to move assets externally, first move the funds to your main account, then you’ll be able to withdraw them through Binance channels that support withdrawals.

#### **Can the AI agent move funds from the account into the Agentic sub-account?**

The agent’s transfer capability is intended for transfers between accounts within the same Agentic sub-account. Funding the Agentic sub-account from your main account is typically a manual step you perform in the Binance UI.

**Agentic sub-account and funding**

#### **Does the AI agent trade in the main account?**

No. Trading is designed to occur in a dedicated Agentic sub-account that is separate from your main account. During onboarding, you may be prompted to create or link an Agentic sub-account as part of authorization.

#### **How to fund the Agentic sub-account?**

Transfer funds from your main account to the Agentic sub-account using the Binance website or App.

Go to** [Sub Accounts] - [Account Management]** and choose** [**[**Transfer**](https://binance.com/en/my/sub-account/asset-management/transfer?asset=BTC)**]** to the selected sub-account.

![image](https://public.bnbstatic.com/image/cms/content/body/202608/53545a6220339491d9c1466c4c478d6b.png)

***Please note:***

- *Menu labels can vary by region and app version.*
- *Consider funding it with only the amount you are comfortable allocating to automated or semi-automated strategies, based on the permissions you grant and your risk tolerance.*

#### **How do you find the Agentic sub-account on Binance website?**

Go to **[Sub Accounts] - [Account Management].** Agentic accounts may be labeled by sub-account type (for example, “Agentic virtual sub”).

![image](https://public.bnbstatic.com/image/cms/content/body/202608/1c27d3e8d1f0640e5a83f193ad8e1df9.png)

**Managing the Agentic sub-account**

#### **How to manage the Agentic sub-account without an agent?**

You can manage it directly by going to **[Sub Accounts] - [Account Management]**. You can deposit and transfer funds in, change account permissions, disconnect agents and turn on the “Emergency Stop” feature. Common actions include transferring funds, reviewing permissions, disconnecting connected agents, and using emergency controls where available.

![image](https://public.bnbstatic.com/image/cms/content/body/202608/48054d6dd5143d83d5af9e7c42b23a77.png)

#### **How to update permissions?**

If your AI agent or authorization flow does not support editing granted scopes in place, you may need to disconnect and reconnect it, then grant the updated scopes during re-authorization.

#### **What is the “Disconnect Agents” feature?**

It disconnects one or more connected agents from the Agentic sub-account. You can reconnect it at any time.

![image](https://public.bnbstatic.com/image/cms/content/body/202608/b8e977cb00d121d09955c0a0cf602854.png)

#### **What is the “Emergency Stop” feature?**

“Emergency Stop” is intended to help you quickly reduce risk in the Agentic sub-account by disabling connected AI agent access and stopping active activity (such as canceling open orders). The exact behavior can vary by product, so review what the UI displays before confirming.

![image](https://public.bnbstatic.com/image/cms/content/body/202608/22a12b400e45fab862df9459059e9119.png)

**Connecting your AI agent**

#### **Which AI agents are supported?**

Currently the list of supported AI agents is: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Codex CLI, ChatGPT and VS Code.

#### **What is the fastest way to get set up?**

Use the MCP endpoint URL below in your AI agent, then complete authorization:

https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic

For agent-specific steps, follow the setup guide in the [official documentation](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/agent-native/mcp-server/agentic).

**Troubleshooting**

#### **My connection is not working. What should I check first?**

Confirm the endpoint is entered exactly as:
https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic

Also confirm your network and AI agent version.

#### **What to do if an authorization expires?**

Disconnect and reconnect in your AI agent, then complete authorization again.

#### **Why does market data work, but trading does not?**

Market data is generally public. Trading requires the Trade scope and product eligibility (for example, region, account status, and Futures enablement, where applicable).

#### **Why did you get an insufficient-balance error?**

The Agentic sub-account may not have sufficient funds in the relevant account. Transfer funds into the Agentic sub-account, and confirm the funds are in the correct account for the product you are using.

### **Get help or report issues**

For more information, please refer to the [official documentation](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/agent-native/mcp-server/agentic). You can also join the [Binance Developer Community](https://dev.binance.vision/c/mcp-server-and-skills/21) and post in the “MCP Server And Skills” category.
